notes.title: New IEH2 Playtest [ver. 0.3.0.0] Re-Launch!
notes.content:
We would like to thank you all for enjoying IEH as always! We have released IEH2 Playtest [ver. 0.3.0.0].
Please bear in mind that this new version will reset your progress, as we have made many changes to the balance of various systems and added some new content as well! We are looking forward to hearing all your feedback during this next playtest round!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1956700/view/3324233322408357930]See the Patch Notes[/url]

As we announced previously, we decided to change the release date to be [b]July 22nd[/b]. 
Today, our original release date, we will start the new IEH2 Playtest! We have put together some appreciation gifts for the participants of new playtest.


[h3]Playtest/IEH1 Players Appreciations Gifts[/h3]

[b]GOING OUT JUNE 10TH: New Playtest ver. 0.3.0.0[/b]
[i]If you participated in the IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:[/i]
    - 3000 Nitro
    - IEH2 DLC Premium Nitro Pack (Use Bonus Code [DLCNitro] to unlock! This is Playtest version only)

[b]GOING OUT JULY 22ND: Early Access Release Day![/b]
[i]If you participated in the IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:[/i]
    - 3000 Nitro
    - 1000 Epic Coin
[i]If you participated in the IEH2 Playtest regardless of date:[/i]
    - Portal Orbs (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in Playtest)
    - [Steam Achievement # you get in Playtest] x 100 Epic Coin
[i]If you’re a returning IEH1 Player[/i]
    - Special Talismans (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in IEH1. Talismans are extra boosts of stats in game.)
[i]If you’re a returning IEH1 Player who purchased the DLC [IEH2 Support Pack][/i]
   - 5500 Epic Coin
   - Accepted Quest Limit + 1

<<The gifts are subject to change>>

So, if you have participated in the playtest prior to this update, you will get 3000 Nitro at start and free DLC Premium Nitro Pack that enables to change nitro speed from x2 to x3! Keep in mind that this free DLC is only during the Playtest and will not transfer to the release version of the game.
For everyone who participates in the new playtest, you can get Steam Achievements and will be rewarded according to how many you can acquire at real release on July 22nd!
We’ve still got quite a lot of incredible content planned before release! Stay tuned and in the meantime thank you for playing our game! 😄


[b]CAUTION[/b]
- Keep in mind that the save file of this Playtest will NOT be available in the official launch.
- All the contents, features and balances in the game are subject to change. 
- In-app purchase in this Playtest is not available.

notes.title: Incremental Epic Hero 2 Playtest
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Hitan from the Hapiwaku IEH development team.
[b]Today, we are pleased to announce a Playtest of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690710/Incremental_Epic_Hero_2/]Incremental Epic Hero 2[/url]![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690710/Incremental_Epic_Hero_2/

We are currently targeting official launch date on [b]June 10th 2022[/b]. 
Toward that goal, we will conduct a public playtest for about a month. This will help us balance the game and improve other various aspects of the game in preparation for the official release.
Please try it and post any feedback! We are very active in [url=https://discord.gg/QEpxWM2fv5]Discord Community[/url] and open to hear your voice to improve the game and make it more fun! Even if you've never played IEH1, you will still enjoy IEH2 🙂

[h3]New Features[/h3]
Though there are a lot of new features in IEH2, let me introduce some of them:
[list]
[*] In addition to the original 3 characters, Warrior/Wizard/Angel, 3 new characters are in IEH2! Thief, Archer and Tamer.
[*] A whole new prestige system for each class and the whole world!
[*] A Town building system that allows you to boost upgrades, unlock new areas, and other parts of the game.
[*] Chat feature in the game that makes gameplay more enjoyable!
[*] New graphics with full HD widescreen and super optimized game performance!
[/list]

[h3]A Completely New Game Compared to IEH1[/h3]
When we first announced about IEH2 in IEH1 page just a year ago, IEH2 was going to be just a remaster of IEH1, but over the past year, IEH2 has become a completely new game compared to IEH1! After several alpha and beta tests, and thanks to our test team and players in Discord, the game has taken an amazing leap forward over the past year.
With only about a month left until this official launch, we would love to have your help to make even more strides. Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/QEpxWM2fv5]Discord Community[/url] and post your great feedback 🙂
Also, please don't forget to add this game to your wishlist so that you don't miss the official release!

[h3]CAUTION[/h3]
- Keep in mind that the save file of this Playtest will NOT be available in the official launch.
- All the contents, features and balances in the game are subject to change. 
- In-app purchase in this Playtest is not available. 


[i]A Message from Dev. Morkyl[/i]
Hi everyone! I'm Morkyl, one of the game designers, here to express our gratitude for any feedback you can offer and to let you know that we are still hard at work designing even more to do and sculpting the game based very much on the feedback we receive.


[i]A Message from Dev. Kei About IEH1[/i]
Hello everyone, thanks for enjoying Incremental Epic Hero on a regular basis! I also apologize for the delay in reporting the progress of the update. I'm currently spending time creating an internal library codings and securing human resources to work on it so that we can update it more efficiently.
The next update is scheduled for around August of this year. Also, we will be doing some collaborative updates with IEH2, so stay tuned!

notes.title: [ver. 1.4.8.0] Added : Expedition & Artifact, IEH finally became an IDLE game!
notes.content:
[b][ver. 1.4.8.0] Added : Expedition & Artifact![/b]

Added : Expedition 
- You can unlock Expedition and expand Expedition slots through completing a quest.
- After spending hours you selected, you will gain three kind of chests that include an Artifact or some materials for Artifacts.

Added : Artifact
- Artifacts have an unique effect and sometimes additional effects.
- Artifacts grow through spending time up to its max level.
- You can raise the max level by using some materials from chests.
- You can expand Artifact Slot and Inventory Slot with Reincarnation upgrades.
- Anti-magic Power now has no effect but will be an important factor for the future update Hidden-Challenge.

Added : Time Warps in Epic Store

Balanced : Offline Bonus now includes expedition progress and artifact growth
Balanced : Increased Nitro Gain during offline from "1 nitro / 8 sec" to "1 nitro / 4 sec"
Fixed : Display bug



[i]Message from Developer Kei[/i]
Hello, everyone. First of all, sorry for the long delay in updating.
In this update, there are some major changes to the system and the save system for continuous updates in the future . (As a result, the file size of the save data for the next update may become very large). As a result, various bugs have arisen and we are taking time to fix them. We apologize to everyone for the long wait.

I also want to let you know about the development of IEH2, which has already started, but rather than being a sequel to IEH1, it has been decided that it will be a game with completely new content (although the basic combat system will be the same). Therefore, IEH1 will continue to be updated continuously as well.

There are a couple of things that concern me about this update. First, a major system modification is changing the save system. It will not affect gameplay, but the size of the save file has been increased. There may also be some potential bugs caused by this. However, this is also necessary for us to keep this game updated for a long time, so we hope you understand.

About Future Update, 
We will be adding more powerful challenge bosses as future updates. Like Curse Reincarnation, there will be restrictions on various stats. Also, higher tier stats will be available and you can enhance them with artifacts. Anti Magic Power will become very important in the next challenge boss.

Please look forward to it!

notes.title: [ver. 1.4.7.0] New 4th Reincarnation Skills! Today is IEH's 1st Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2][ver. 1.4.7.0] The New 4th Reincarnation Skills![/h2]

Added : The 4th Reincarnation Skills, which have [b]"Auto-Rebirth"[/b] and "[b]"Auto-Reincarnation"[/b] in passive effect
- [b]Auto-Rebirth[/b] : You can select any area after 1-5 where you automatically rebirth to the same class just when clear the area (unavailable at curse of rein)
- [b]Auto-Reincarnation[/b] : You can automatically reincarnate to the same class when you clear area 5-4 with 1e20 or more dps (unavailable at curse of rein)

Added : New QoL stuffs in QoL 4 of Epic Store
- [b]Persistent Super Queue[/b] : Allows for Super Queue assignments to be preserved through Reincarnation, including Slime Bank.
- [b]Persistent Favorite Craft[/b] : Allows for Favorite Crafts to persist through Reincarnation. The Evolution # will be halved and the level will be 1 every Reincarnation.

Balanced : Nitro now persists through Reincarnation

Balanced : Decreased worker cost in Dark Ritual

Balanced : # of Available Favorite Crafts now doesn't count quest rewards and challenge reward

Fixed : Mission Milestone 325 bug

Fixed : The bug that toggles sometimes didn't save/load through rebirth and reincarnation

My friend, Kazuma, has released [b]Your Chronicle (YC)[/b] on Steam! 
This game is a text-based idle RPG. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546320/Your_Chronicle/

To commemorate this, we hold a simple collaboration event!

Thank you for all your comment! There are still few idle games in Japan. We are very active to develop idle games and want to spread its excitement all over the world from Japan!
